lines.t:
The <c:ffff00>{{slot}}<c> equivalent to a <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c>'s left arm. It has a
<c:ffff00>skill<c>, an <c:ffff00>action<c>, and these <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c>: <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{success}}<c>,
<c:ffff00>{{power}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c>.
Unlike the <c:ffff00>head<c> {{part}}, it can use its action any
number of times unless <c:ffff00>destroyed<c>. As a <c:ffff00>{{response}}<c> to
an <c:ffff00>attack<c>, it can <c:ffff00>defend<c>.
When the <c:ffff00>{{charge_gauge}}<c> fills, a stat rises depending
on the skill: {{power}} (<c:ffff00>Striking<c>), {{success}} (<c:ffff00>Shooting<c>),
{{cooldown}} (<c:ffff00>Support<c>, <c:ffff00>Set-up<c>) or {{prep}} (<c:ffff00>Heal<c>, <c:ffff00>Block<c>).
